tools.name: Agentic_RL_list_sources
tools.description: List original papers and retrieval coverage. Discover source-linked comparisons of credit assignment, agent memory, selective observation and terminal benchmarks, with JSON, CSV and BibTeX links.

tools.name: Agentic_RL_search_evidence
tools.description: Search original papers on agentic reinforcement learning, credit assignment and CLI agents. Use English keywords (AND), OR and quoted phrases. Return relevant passages, source citations, equations and table cells.

tools.name: Agentic_RL_fetch_evidence
tools.description: Fetch a complete original evidence block by the evidence_id returned from search_evidence, including section anchor, version, equations, table cells, links, and attribution.

tools.name: Agentic_RL_dataset_overview
tools.description: Inspect ShellOps and ShellOps-Pro task counts, train/test splits, task types, published schemas, source files, license and citation.

tools.name: Agentic_RL_search_tasks
tools.description: Find real ShellOps CLI benchmark tasks by case-insensitive literal substring in the complete instruction, task ID or published task type. Empty query lists all tasks. Select partition 'all', 'shellops' or 'shellops_pro'; select published split 'all', 'train_src', 'train' or 'test'. Results are order

tools.name: Agentic_RL_get_task
tools.description: Inspect one published ShellOps or ShellOps-Pro task by its exact task_id and partition ('shellops' or 'shellops_pro'). Returns the complete instruction, actual reward specification, published reference answer/command, file-entry metadata, pinned parquet rows and workspace asset links. File content i

tools.name: Agentic_RL_list_method_facets
tools.description: List exact filter values for agent RL credit granularity, supervision, value critics and evaluation settings. Each value reports its source-supported method count.

tools.name: Agentic_RL_filter_methods
tools.description: Filter agent RL credit-assignment methods by research conditions and return original section evidence and BibTeX. Discover accepted values with list_method_facets. Filters combine with AND; empty strings leave a facet unrestricted. Unknown critic status never matches no. Results use publication orde
